$comment: Philippine non-working days used for deadline shifting. 2026: per Proclamation No. 1006 (verified Aug 4, 2026, incl. the separately proclaimed Eid dates). 2027: statutory/computable holidays only; the 2027 proclamation is normally issued late 2026, and movable and special dates get added when it issues. Special WORKING days (e.g. EDSA anniversary) are excluded; offices are open. Eid'l Fitr / Eid'l Adha 2027 are omitted until proclaimed.

shiftRule.value: A filing/payment deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday, or non-working holiday moves to the next working day
legalBasis: The rule printed in the BIR's annual Tax Calendar and form instructions ('If the due date falls on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, the deadline shall be moved to the next working day')
RR 26-2002 (same treatment in the eFPS staggered-filing framework)
shiftRule.notes: Applied to BIR deadlines and, as the safe default, to SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG/LGU/SEC dates. Deadlines only ever move later, never earlier; weekday special non-working days (Dec 8, Dec 24, Dec 31) shift deadlines just like regular holidays; purely LOCAL holidays do not move national e-filing deadlines. The 13th-month-pay deadline is an exception — it must be met on or before Dec 24.

confidenceNote: 2026 dates are verified against Proclamation No. 1006. The 2027 rows are the statutory/computable holidays only — the 2027 proclamation had not issued as of the verification date, and the movable Eid dates are omitted entirely, so deadlines shifting across a 2027 holiday need confirming.

holidays.name: Maundy Thursday (statutory movable; Easter 2027 is Mar 28)
National Heroes Day (last Monday of August)
Feast of the Immaculate Conception (statutory, RA 10966)
Last Day of the Year (statutory, EO 292 as amended by RA 9492)

notes2027.notes: The 2027 rows are the statutory holidays (fixed and computable) — no proclamation needed for these. Still pending the 2027 proclamation (expected Sept–Oct 2026, based on recent years) and to be added when proclaimed: the 2027 Eid dates (astronomical estimates: Eid'l Fitr ~Mar 9, Eid'l Adha ~May 16), Chinese New Year (Feb 6 — a Saturday), Black Saturday (Mar 27 — a Saturday), and the customary discretionary days Nov 2 and Dec 24 (Dec 24, 2027 is a FRIDAY — watch it). Nov 2, 2026 is also barangay/SK election day under RA 12232 — already non-working as All Souls' Day.
